source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), the Librarian’s unit can make a D6 psychic roll while it is free of **battle-shock**. On a 1 the unit becomes **battle-shocked**. Give its melee attacks +2 **S**.
